name: smwsprites-spiny-shell-v1
title: Spiny Shell v1.1
description:
This is a spiny shell. Mario can't pick it up or kick it, but other than that, it's an ordinary shell.

v1.1 by Darolac

What's new:

-Fixed several bugs/oddities regarding sprite's direction
that affected interaction with shell-less koopas.

-Added a define to control if the shell-less koopas should be able to catch the sprite when in its kicked state.

-Fixed star and Yoshi interaction.

-Added proper interaction with purple triangles.
